title: Phantom Base

{{Infobox map |name=Phantom Base |year=2021 |image=Phantom_base.jpg |creator=[[Image:flag_nl.gif]] [[QuakeR]] |gametype=4on4, FFA |size=Large |download=https://maps.quakeworld.nu/all/phantombase.bsp }} Phantom Base is a 4on4 Team Deathmatch map created from January to March 2021 by [[Image:flag_nl.gif]] [[QuakeR]].
===Spawns=== There are 8 spawnpoints.
Peculiarity: there are 3 SSG's, one at each armor, all near a spawn.
Even though the map was designed for 4on4 Team Deathmatch, all spawns are near a weapon, this was done with FFA in mind. ===Layout=== The map basically consists of a floor-level, a first-level and a sewer.
Once one learns the map one discovers things, such as items, weapons and possibilities. Phantom_1_overview.jpg ===Strategy & Tactics=== Some possible match start spawn tactics: '''Spawn LG:''' : LG spawn can get LG in 3 sec : maybe then pickup the 6-cell-pack in the corridor towards RA; : get (second) RA (and hope enemy doesn't have Quad or Pent) '''Spawn GA/SSG(1):''' : 3 sec to QUAD - when taking SSG : 4 sec to QUAD - when taking SSG & GA '''Spawn YA/SSG(2):''' : 5 sec to QUAD - when taking SSG & YA -> tele : ignoring YA : could get RING in 5 sec [but clash with RL guy(s)] '''Spawn RA/SNG (RA room):''' : 5 sec to PENT (will not get RA) '''Spawn RA/SSG(3):''' : gets RA : : OR : when ignoring RA : : 5 sec to PENT using 2 teleporters '''Spawn low-RL (sewer/water):''' '''Spawn high-RL: Spawn GL:''' : 6 sec to RING '''NOTE:'''
PENT can shoot HATCH and go to RING (7 sec) but PENT will probably hunt QUAD
If all 4|5|6 that can make it in 6|7 seconds to RING, go to RING :
there will be 2 RL's, 1 GL, a RA/SSG, a PENT/SNG/SG and a Quad @RING => (FIREWORKS) ===Items=== {{MapItems |quad=1 |ring=1 |pent=1 |hp100=1 |ra=1 |ya=1 |ga=1 |lg=1 |rl=2 |gl=1 |sng=1 |ng= |ssg=3 }} ==Gallery== Phantom_quad.jpg Phantom_rl.jpg Phantom_lg.jpg [[Category:Maps]] [[Category:4on4 Maps]]
